source: design_system/v1_0_threejs_soulslike/TUNING_V0.md hitstop table (verbatim), GATES.md F4/A3, ART_BIBLE L4/L8/EN14, DECISIONS.md D9; slice s27-vfx contract

hitstopClasses._comment: hitstopTicks are the TUNING_V0 Hitstop row verbatim (Light 3 · heavy 6 · charged 8 · blocked 5 · guard-break 9 · critical/death 12). bloomTicks pair the ink-bloom with the hitstop class (TUNING_V0: 'View adds ink-bloom at frame margin'); the authored decay tail beyond the freeze is recorded per class. peakIntensity and radiusPx are authored presentation values (no TUNING row governs view bloom size; bounded by the L8/A3 budget below).

budget._comment: L8 / gate A3: oxblood hue-mask coverage ceiling outside declared red-field states. The margin ink-bloom is oxblood and must respect it; blooms are brief.

inversion._comment: Council canon impact spec: 1-frame parchment inversion on criticals (TUNING_V0 Hitstop row; slice: critical/death). Exactly one presented frame, never more.

impactStrokes._comment: World-space ink-stroke hit flashes: 3 authored stroke variants (slash / cross / blot), hatched line-work, never particle spray (AD9). Duration = hitstop freeze + authored tail. Gold is licensed ONLY for riposte/guard-break — the single small gold flash of the earned opening (slice deliverable 2; AD6 otherwise bans it).

wither._comment: EN14: ambient Wither = margin desaturation band + sparse ink motes; never green fog, never corruption splash. Density is data-driven and hard-capped.

flask._comment: Vial glow = registered emblem light pulse during the drink (L4 verb `mercy`, slice-licensed verb extension; KA4: the vial's jewel glint is Kalev's one licensed warm accent, runtime emblem light only).

ember._comment: Ember use = brief gold-to-grey world desaturation sweep (the Numbness moment made visible once, then gone). 60t is the slice-contract value; stops are stepped, never continuous (L3).

tagChime._comment: Tiny tin glint on snare-ring contact, pairing the audio tell (PR5: tags chime on contact). Tin/parchment flash, never gold (WR5).

deathPage._comment: Death 'page' treatment hook (slice goal): the lower page dims for a beat while the Open Page scatters (D6/F11). Hook only — full treatment is integration work.

margin._comment: Bloom anchors sit on the manuscript border's margin inset; matches the s16 HUD baseInsetPx so bloom and border agree at integration (authored presentation geometry).

demo._comment: ?scene=vfx scripted timeline: one row per scripted event, exercising every effect for the e2e captures (slice deliverable 6).
